name: m5-t1-weak-vs-kwu-2

variantDescriptions.weak: one compile at a time, today's `WeakHashSet` uniques table, every type interned
variantDescriptions.kwu: one compile at a time, `ChunkedInterner(weak = true)` and types made in the weak scopes not interned

description: One compile at a time (JMH `-t 1`, single shot, 20 warmup compiles), the counterpart of m5-t8-weak-vs-kwu-2 (job 578), 24 GB G1 heap, laptop, separate forks, 3 per variant. Read GC pause sums from `gc.log` too. Build `claude/uniques-audit-2.13.x` `1e85ab8eba`: the prototypes merged with upstream 2.13.x, which brings scala/scala#11367 (no megamorphic interface calls to the analyzer when several `Global`s share a JVM; without it the earlier forks spent 2-4% of compile-thread cycles in itable stubs under `Typer.typed`).
